FILER_Nott_ATAC_tracks.terms_summary: FILER states that external data users may freely download, analyze and publish results based on any FILER data.
FILER_Nott_ATAC_tracks.citation_and_acknowledgement: FILER requests citation of the FILER paper, the original publications producing the raw data, and acknowledgement of their funding.

UCSC_hg19_hg38_chain_files.terms_summary: UCSC chain files may be downloaded, used and redistributed for non-commercial use by independent researchers/nonprofit organizations; commercial use requires a UCSC license.
UCSC_hg19_hg38_chain_files.redistribution_note: UCSC states redistribution of chain files must include the applicable README/license restrictions.
UCSC_hg19_hg38_chain_files.tool_note: The UCSC liftOver executable/software has separate licensing terms from the chain files. Academic/nonprofit use is described as free; commercial use requires licensing.
